memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "As for any fabric that is spoiled with a defiling mould — any woollen or linen clothing, any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather — if the affected area in the fabric, the leather, the woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a defiling mould and must be shown to the priest." - Lev 13:47-49 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter now turns from skin to cloth. The same word, the same procedure, applied to a garment, a woven cloth, a leather bag.

This is one reason we know tzara'at was never simply a medical condition. No disease of the human body appears in a coat. God is teaching through a picture, and the picture has widened: this corruption does not stay in one place. It gets into the things around us.

Think about how that works in a life. A man's dishonesty at work does not stay at work — it comes home in the way he talks to his wife. A woman's bitterness towards her sister shapes what her children absorb about forgiveness. A habit kept in secret changes how a person prays, how they read Scripture, how freely they can look others in the eye.

Nothing sinful stays personal. It spreads into our relationships, our homes, our churches, the atmosphere our families breathe.

And God's instruction is unchanged: it must be shown to the priest. Bring it out. Let it be examined. That is not a cruel demand; it is the only path to dealing with something before it works through the whole garment.

We have a great High Priest who has ascended into heaven, and we can approach His throne of grace with confidence (Heb 4:14-16).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How has something in your life spread beyond you into your home or relationships?
2. What "garment" in your life needs to be brought to the Priest?
3. Who is affected by the things you keep private?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, I see how what I keep hidden seeps into everything around me. I bring it to You honestly today, and I ask You to stop the spread. Amen.
